usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.text:
_Ring, Legendary_

While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast _Wish_ from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.
